test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Syed Modi India International is organised in which sporting event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badminton**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Syed Modi International Badminton Championships, **an esteemed international badminton competition, takes place annually in** India**.
 
• Introduced to the badminton circuit as a **BWF Grand Prix event in 2009,** it has since become a staple in the sport's calendar.
 
• Typically held at the **Babu Banarasi Das Indoor Stadium** in Lucknow, the tournament briefly moved to Hyderabad in 2010 before returning to its usual venue.
 
• Notably, in 2011, it was elevated to the status of a Grand Prix Gold event. With the Badminton World Federation's restructuring of events in 2017, the tournament gained even greater recognition, being classified as a BWF World Tour Super 300 event starting from 2018, attracting top players from around the globe. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Badminton,** a racquet sport where players use racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net, is overseen in India by the Badminton Association of India.
 
• Indian badminton boasts a strong presence on the global stage, with players such as P. V. Sindhu, Lakshya Sen, H. S. Prannoy, and the doubles duo of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty consistently ranking within the Top 10 in the current BWF world rankings.
 
• Prakash Padukone made history as the first Indian player to reach the world no. 1 spot, followed by Srikanth Kidambi, who achieved this milestone in April 2018.
 
• Saina Nehwal holds several notable distinctions, including being the first female player from India to attain the world no. 1 ranking in April 2015.
 
• She is celebrated as the first Indian badminton player to secure an Olympic Games medal, marking a significant achievement in the sport's history for the country.
